name: Notice (generic)
notes: Client: cinematic state, input notices. Server: tutorial hint.

name: Create / update object (with properties)
notes: Batch 0x4 with 0xF2 descriptor. To a live object it rebuilds nothing: 0xF2 is a no-op while its u32 equals entity+0x110 (0); 0xBC is a diff (0x62AFD0: sets the sent ids as 0x6 does, removes the object's own net-mode 1/3 ids it omits); 0xB0 is one more movement state; a batch with only 0xB0 reaches the same listener 0x60AFA0 (object-update-bundles.md, fase3-if). ics [ics] object_update_mode "delta" (fase3-if): the full batch only creates an object (and for creation retries, a champion's death / respawn, array / table changes); its updates are a batch with only the 0xB0 plus 0x6 / 0x86 (World.delta).

name: Set one property
notes: u8 0 | property entry (u32 id, packed id, value); handler 0x635360 -> collection change path. ics: late unit flags (fase3-gd); fase3-if delta updates: one per changed property of a live object (World.delta; an equal value notifies nothing, 0x578DE0). Open: the static read path 0x445530 is base u8 + 0x509740 (packed id + value, the 0xBC table's per-entry reader) with no u32 before it, yet ics's u32-first form works in the game (2026-10-23 diag --target: a 0 -> flags toggle by 0x6 set the unit cache).

name: Vitals (health, secondary resource)
notes: Only to objects with a vitals component. Sent with every champion bundle. Handler 0xAB2880 -> 0xAB1BD0 dereferences [entity+0x80] with no null check (crash rva 0x6B1BD9); the component exists only if PerceivedType 0x1000019D & 0x7F59FB at creation; ics checks that (vitals_need_perceived_type, fase3-in).

name: Remove one property
notes: u8 0 | u32 id (reader 0x839500); exec 0x699210 -> 0x6353B0 -> property component vt+0x54 (0x577E10): notified as removed, or as changed back to the class template's value (object-update-bundles.md). ics fase3-if (P, never seen in the game yet): one per id of network mode 1 / 3 (MasterProperty 0x32000000) that left a live object's list, what a full bundle's 0xBC removed ([ics] delta_remove_missing; net-0 ids only with delta_remove_net0).

name: Destruction impulse (sphere): u8 0 | Position | f32 radius | magnitude | u32 level | u32 hit key | u32 FX | u8
notes: Exec 0x698350, handler 0x632590 -> 0x632370: impulse object 0x630E80, physics sphere query 0x631C50 (0x5CEA30; piece bodies 0x631B00, destructible entities 0x631940), applied by 0x631FA0 only when something was found: piece health -= magnitude (0x62F290 -> 0x62BEF0 -> 0x62BC00), break at <= 0. Breaks only pieces whose bodies (made by 0x8B at the entity's frame) are inside the sphere: ics rebuilds a landed vehicle (0x8B) first ([ics] liftable_land_rebuild, fase3-im; liftable-throw-destruction.md 3). full-protocol.tsv; ics (fase3-gm, fase3-ij)

name: Start scriptlets on an entity
notes: Animations, VFX, sounds; key must be in the entity's table. Replaces: the list handler 0x627E20 first stops every run an earlier network order started on the object (0x627E4D -> 0x57CB60, filter vtable 0x15C9750 / 0x6272D0 = context byte +0x60), then starts or signals the entries (0x6279D0); a dead run's number starts a new run. ics sends a champion's orders of one moment as one 0x8D and re-sends its held StartScriptlet runs in each ([ics] scriptlet_orders, ics/scriptlet_orders.py).

name: Movement state (batch sub-event or standalone)
notes: Exec 0x698CD0 -> 0x6298D0: the object's 0xB0 listeners (movement 0x60AFA0: merge 0x57DA90, push 0x609C70, same module seq = no-op 0x553E70; containment 0x6113E0: parent IID 0 only clears a queued attach). ics sends it inside 0x4 (object-update-bundles.md); fase3-if delta mode: alone in a 0x4 batch for every update of a live object (pvp_movement_state, with the 0x04 attach block; same bytes as the bundle's). Motion bits 0x400 (s16 facing pitch) / 0x4000 (s16 roll), rad * 10000 after the facing yaw: sent for a thrown vehicle's nose-down ([ics] liftable_throw_pitch, fase3-il, agl-arm-meteor-vehicle-tilt.md 3).

name: Set a property table (batch sub-event or standalone)
notes: Exec 0x699330 -> 0x635440 -> vt+0xA4 0x62AFD0: equal values notify nothing (deep compare for arrays / tables), changed ids notify, omitted own ids of net mode 1 / 3 are removed. ics sends it inside 0x4 (object-update-bundles.md).

name: Stop a scriptlet run on an entity
notes: u8 0 | u32 key | u32 run instance (0xFFFFFFFF = every run of the key) | u8 flag (0 / 1). Serializer 0x6751A0, exec 0x675280 -> script component 0x57C4B0 -> 0x529EF0 (end list, state 5, attachments released). The real stop: a 0x8D with a live run's instance and a signal bit only runs the definition's signal handlers (0x534290). Builder ics/messages.py stop_scriptlet (fase3-if); sent only with the opt-in [ics] death_overlay_scriptlets, to end _CDefeatSystem_DeathOverlay's run at the respawn and at the match end ([ics] death_overlay_stop) (docs/re-notes/death-animation.md 4, 11). fase3-ih: also at the Crime Alley relay's unlock (Raider arrival): stops Vfx_Locked, every run ([ics] match_nook_pad unlock_stop; throw-truck-padlock.md 4). fase3-ij: the u8 is 0x57C4B0's mode argument (passed to the component's vt+0x7C); the client's own StopScriptletKey path 0x588A80 passes 1; the relay stop now sends 1 for Vfx_Locked and _Selection_Usage_Locked, again 0.5 / 2 s later (unlock_stop_flag / unlock_stop_again; throw-padlock-coredeath.md 2). A script's StopScriptlet now goes as 0x11F with u8 1 ([ics] scriptlet_orders).

name: Accolades
notes: Scorecard. Sent at the match end and again 1.5 s after the scorecard's 0x212E (fase3-ip, [ics] scorecard_accolades_resend): Flash AccoladesDisplay waits for ACCOLADES_RECVD, raised only when the accolades notice comes after every other scorecard piece (the scorecard asks for it before the header). fase3-is: C 0xA61DA0 returns before Flash when the accolade-record list (the 2nd list) is empty, so the empty copy never reached Flash (the fase3-ip resend had no effect); the late copy is now 0x2104 with the encounter. Lists after the StringInfo: list 1 unused, list 2 accolade records (0x48...), list 3 medal type 1-3, bytelist, lists 4-5 compared by 0xA344C0 (value vs best, P).

name: Skill script event
notes: u8 0 | u64 agent | u32 slot | u32 1 | u32 event | u8 0 (serializer 0x849ce0, handler 0xa1d400 -> 0xa16e60): raises a ScriptEvent on the client copy of the slot's skill script. ics sends 0x1000001D (skill used) after each cast, 0x10000009 on a refusal: it ends the range indicator (fase3-hd).

name: Skill availability event
notes: u8 0 | u64 agent | u32 slot | u8 available (serializer 0x839550, handler 0xa2a1b0): raises ScriptEvent 0x100000B6 (0) / 0x100000B7 (1) with parameter SkillSlot 0x31D944 on the client copy of the slot's skill script (0xa16e60). The Super Strength throw sub-skills' client script 0x340001A3 starts the slot's targeting indicator on 0x100000B6 and ends it on 0x100000B7; ics sends 0 when a carry is ready to throw, 1 at the throw / drop ([ics] liftable_throw_indicator, fase3-ih; throw-truck-padlock.md 1). fase3-ij: that start (node 0x10000056 -> 0xa5dab0 with flag 0) draws only when the slot is the HUD controller's current targeting slot (+0x90 +0xEC), so nothing showed during a carry; 0x2180 / 0x217F now draw / end it (throw-padlock-coredeath.md 1).

notes: u32 message | u32 n | blob (captured fase3-hm, no leading u8). Emote = message 0x81970006 (CEmoteSystem 0x28F:1, Alt+Numpad1-5), blob u32 emote record DID (0x40000241 Joke, 0x40000240 Taunt, 0x40000242 Laugh, 0x4000023F Dance, 0x40000EE6 Oath); ics raises the champion graph's Emote_* event (fase3-hk). Other messages logged.

name: Web ticket (iface d4bce8af)
notes: Not sent. u8 0 | GUID | u32 shard; stored by 0x420920 in the app's web-ticket object; the UI_RequestWebTicket listener 0x420B90 answers the store / amplifier screens with it at once (zero GUID when never sent), then asks the server with client 0x0095. Not needed for the local store page (store-amplifiers.md, store-fix.md 2.1).

name: Web ticket request (after UI_RequestWebTicket)
notes: Empty body, dest 0x0600000000000415. Built only by 0x692DF0, called only by the web-ticket listener 0x420B90 after it answered the UI from the stored ticket: one per store (SHOP) open (the Assembler's store links are dead code). The answer would be 0xC2. fase3-ie left it in unhandled.log; fase3-if logs "web ticket request (0x95)" in server.log and sends nothing (store-fix.md).

name: Order buffer: current action slot
notes: u8 0 | u32 (serializer 0x839500, exec 0x8bc730, handler 0xa1a5a0): [[root+0x90]+0xC0] = u32, i.e. the order buffer (controller+0x48) +0x78 that 0x863860 compares with a skill order's slot (-2 holds every skill order, another slot holds skills with bool 0x10000704). Not sent by ics (default -1). liftable-carry-throw-press.md 1.
